details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml:1027 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The "Create tracking issue" step calls `ensure_label_exists` without sourcing `scripts/label_helpers.sh`, where the function is defined.
  WHY: Under `set -euo pipefail`, every promote-cycle dispatch fails after creating an unlabelled tracking issue but before posting the marker or writing `tracking_issue_number`.

- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:198-201 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `last_cycle_baseline_sha` applies jq `capture(...)` to every comment body without `?` or prior marker filtering.
  WHY: Non-marker state or progress comments make jq fail after the first cycle, causing all later cycles to skip with `guard_unavailable`.

- agents.md:1216-1264 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The generated workflow tree omits `.github/workflows/auto-release-stable.yml`.
  WHY: `make generate-check` already fails with `agents.md is out of date`.

- docs/INVENTORY.md:Workflows and Scripts sections | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The inventory omits `.github/workflows/auto-release-stable.yml`, `scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh`, `scripts/auto_release_stable.sh`, and `scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh`.
  WHY: `tests/inventory_parity.py` fails because tracked workflow and script paths are not represented in the inventory.

- .github/workflows/ci.yml and release-gate test lists | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The five new test modules cited by the PR are not referenced by CI or the release-gate validation lists.
  WHY: The repository explicitly enumerates tests rather than discovering the directory, so the claimed verification suites are not regression-gated.

- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:5538 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The notify job requires `RELEASE=success` even though `gate_only=true` intentionally skips the release job.
  WHY: Passing smoke gates produce false `Release ... FAILED` Telegram alerts.

- .github/workflows/implement.yml:5245-5257 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `gh issue edit --add-label 'ai:blocked' ... >/dev/null 2>&1 || true` suppresses label-application failures while terminalization is reported unconditionally.
  WHY: The issue can remain `ai:implementing`, allowing stall recovery to re-dispatch `/approved` despite the `IMPLEMENT_BLOCKED_TERMINALIZED` log and comment.

- scripts/auto_release_stable.sh:88-99 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The tag-ref lookup conflates a genuinely missing tag with API, network, rate-limit, or authorization failures.
  WHY: A failed lookup is treated as an unreleased branch and can dispatch redundant release gates against already-released content.

- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:171-183 and 262-270 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: A failed `stable` tag-ref lookup returns empty and bypasses the `require_code_changes` guard.
  WHY: An API failure can trigger an unnecessary multi-hour smoke gate and proving run when `main` has not changed.

- scripts/auto_release_stable.sh:105-110 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The in-flight guard checks only `test-and-mark-stable.yml` and does not account for concurrent `promote-main-to-stable.yml` runs or the poller's release dispatch.
  WHY: Two release gates can run concurrently and race to compute and push the same tag.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10340,10353 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: A failed default-branch ref lookup leaves `main_tip` empty but still dispatches a verifying run with `APPLY_ANALYSIS_PROMOTE_SHA=""`.
  WHY: The verifying project cannot promote and wastes a full orchestrator run; severity is high.

- .github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml:122-124 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `cancel-in-progress: false` queues scheduled cycle runs behind a cycle that may wait up to five hours.
  WHY: The queued run cannot execute `another_run_active` until it starts and may process stale or redundant promotion state; moonshotai_kimi-k3 rated this as nit because the script re-resolves `main`, creating a severity disagreement.

- agents.md:773-796, 895-1005 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `COMPREHENSIVE_PROMOTION_SKIPPED` and `COMPREHENSIVE_VERIFYING_COMPLETE` are absent from the stable-prefix catalog, and the `LOG_PREFIX.name=` mirror contains none of the new prefixes.
  WHY: Log-analysis and API-hygiene consumers cannot recognize the new telemetry under the documented prefix contract.

- docs/scripts-pending-removal.md:58 and 70 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Both new registry entries use `claude/auto-apply-analysis-release-main (2026-09-19)` instead of a PR number and date.
  WHY: The entries lose durable provenance after branch deletion.

- changelog.d/auto-apply-analysis-and-stable-release.md:filename | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The changelog fragment filename lacks the required numeric `<issue-or-pr>-` prefix.
  WHY: The fragment path can collide with another PR using the same slug.

- scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh:87,320 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The script does not reject a non-`main` `GITHUB_REF_NAME`.
  WHY: Manual dispatch from a feature branch can analyze content that the main-anchored promotion flow cannot promote.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10237-10545 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: After compare failures, a later stale or incomplete successful compare response can be accepted without a fresh quiescence validation.
  WHY: The promotion may dispatch while untested commits remain.

- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:236-247 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The smoke-gate polling loop matches the first workflow run not present in `before_gate_ids`, without uniquely binding it to the dispatch.
  WHY: An unrelated concurrent `test-and-mark-stable.yml` run can be treated as the cycle's gate.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10438-10453 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Persistent compare API failure past the hold cap marks promotion failed and returns success, allowing final merge without promotion.
  WHY: The project can complete with `stable` unupdated and no recovery path.

- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:env block around line 693 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: The poller environment does not forward `APPLY_ANALYSIS_ON_MAIN_ENABLED`.
  WHY: The documented kill switch is ineffective for verifying-run dispatches initiated by the poller.

- scripts/auto_release_stable.sh:1-124 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The supervisor automatically dispatches release workflows with a token capable of release-side effects and no distinct runtime safety gate.
  WHY: A compromised runner token can trigger arbitrary automated releases; the reviewer identified this as a trust-boundary risk.

- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:1-339 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The supervisor automatically dispatches release gates and orchestrator projects using repository action and LLM-token capabilities.
  WHY: A compromised dispatch-capable token can trigger repeated release and orchestrator activity; the reviewer identified this as a trust-boundary risk.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
